title: Wuying-Browser-Agent: Real-World Centric Fundamental Long-Horizon Browser Agents
summary: Long-horizon browser agents designed for tasks in real-world web environments.

title: MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attributed Property Graph
summary: Structured knowledge and visual retrieval to support multimodal reasoning in microscopy.
aliases: MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attribute Graph

title: Non-Uniform Class-Wise Coreset Selection for Vision Model Fine-tuning
summary: Difficulty-aware selection allocates data budgets across classes for efficient model fine-tuning.

title: Efficient Trajectory Space-Time Super-Resolution for Fast Live-cell Imaging
summary: We propose Trajectory Space-Time Super-Resolution (T-STSR), a method designed to boost frame rates and resolution in fast subcellular imaging while significantly reducing computational overhead.

title: A data-efficient strategy for building high-performing medical foundation models
summary: We show that pretraining on approximately one million synthetic images allows a retinal foundation model trained on only 16.7% of 904,170 real images to match or exceed the performance of RETFound trained on the full dataset across nine tasks.

title: Efficient Online Training for Zero-Shot Time-Lapse Microscopy Denoising and Super-Resolution
summary: We introduce MDSR-Zero, a zero-shot online learning method designed for plug-and-play noise suppression and super-resolution of microscopy videos.

title: MicroVQA++: High-Quality Microscopy Reasoning Dataset with Weakly Supervised Graphs for Multimodal Large Language Model
summary: A microscopy visual-question-answering corpus with graph-based quality control and human screening.

title: Self-Explained Thinking Agent for Autonomous Microscopy Restoration
summary: An agent that reasons about image degradation, selects restoration strategies, and explains its decisions.

title: Unifying Segment Anything in Microscopy with Vision-Language Knowledge
summary: Vision-language knowledge guides Segment Anything toward cross-domain microscopy segmentation.

title: Subcellular behavior model enables highly precise temporal super-resolved live-cell imaging
summary: Behavior-aware particle matching improves interpolation for fast live-cell imaging.

title: FacialFlowNet: Advancing Facial Optical Flow Estimation with a Diverse Dataset and a Decomposed Model
summary: A diverse facial optical-flow dataset and a decomposed model for facial motion estimation.

title: Pretraining a foundation model for generalizable fluorescence microscopy-based image restoration
summary: We provide a universal fluorescence microscopy-based image restoration (UniFMIR) model to address different restoration problems, and show that UniFMIR offers higher image restoration precision, better generalization and increased versatility.

title: Low-latency Space-time Supersampling for Real-time Rendering
summary: A unified approach to frame supersampling and extrapolation for low-latency real-time rendering.

title: SAMFlow: Eliminating Any Fragmentation in Optical Flow with Segment Anything Model
summary: Through theoretical analysis, we find the pre-trained large vision models are helpful in optical flow estimation, and SAM is suitable for solving the fragmentation problem.

title: Context-Aware Iteration Policy Network for Efficient Optical Flow Estimation
summary: A learned iteration policy adapts the computation budget to each optical-flow sample.

title: Uncertainty-Guided Spatial Pruning Architecture for Efficient Frame Interpolation
summary: We develop an Uncertainty-Guided Spatial Pruning (UGSP) architecture to skip redundant computation for efficient frame interpolation dynamically.

title: MVFlow: Deep Optical Flow Estimation of Compressed Videos with Motion Vector Prior
summary: We propose an optical flow model, MVFlow, which uses motion vectors to improve the speed and accuracy of optical flow estimation for compressed videos.

title: Motion Matters: Difference-based Multi-scale Learning for Infrared UAV Detection
summary: Multi-frame differences and multi-scale features improve infrared UAV detection.

title: Fine-grained Blind Face Inpainting with 3D Face Component Disentanglement
summary: We propose a novel fine-grained blind face inpainting framework and build up a new dataset called CelebO-3D.

title: A Generative Framework for Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning
summary: A 3D-aware generative framework disentangles facial identity and expression without paired supervision.
aliases: Unsupervised disentangling of facial representations with 3D-aware latent diffusion models

title: Instruct-NeuralTalker: Editing Audio-Driven Talking Radiance Fields with Instructions
summary: Text instructions edit audio-driven neural talking faces while preserving lip synchronization.

title: Co-completion for occluded facial expression recognition
summary: We propose a task-specific framework which first combines occlusion discarding and feature completion together to reduce the interference of occlusions on instance level.

title: Feature Pyramid Network for Multi-task Affective Analysis
summary: Hierarchical representations connect valence-arousal estimation, expression recognition, and action-unit detection.
